reviews.title: Amazing Sound Value
reviews.comment: One of the best pieces of sound equipment I’ve ever owned. No matter what I attach it to it is a massive upgrade. I’ve used it w/ iPhones, Canon R-Series cameras, etc., in a multitude of situations & it is very compatible, the perfect size for tight, portable scenarios and is a BREEZE to set up. Some may not want to dump a c-note to get this kind of return, but you won’t be disappointed. Never had one negative experience with it.
reviews.author: stu623

reviews.title: Excellent on-camera microphone for vlogging.
reviews.comment: I have used the Wireless Go 2 mic and the Rode NT1-A studio microphone, and I find the RØDE VideoMic GO II to be a perfect choice for my needs, which include vlogging on YouTube and some podcasts. It is plug-and-play, significantly reducing the time it takes for me to set up and start recording. The microphone is lightweight and delivers excellent sound quality, with a slightly bassy tone that can easily be adjusted with EQ. It’s incredibly user-friendly and compatible with any device, making it very portable. The VideoMic GO II can be mounted using a cold shoe or the quarter-inch thread underneath, and it features a great shock mount. Additionally, it operates without a battery, adding to its convenience. I would recommend this microphone to anyone looking for an on-camera option. It can also be used with a computer or a phone for calls, which is great; you just need the right cable for phone use. Priced reasonably, it’s a fantastic option, especially if you can find a used one.

reviews.title: A great little budget mic that works well
reviews.comment: I used to use a more expensive Rode mic that I got in 2013. I didn't want to spend $200+ this time so I tried this out. In my opinion, it works just as well as more expensive mics I've used. Great voice isolation and background canceling. Not perfect and may sometimes require a little tweaking in post. But this is a great mic that replaced my more experience one
